_comment: Local overrides for yucatan_realtime_testing, equivalent to the overrides in realtime_yucatan_long_range.m (UWLS only, 15 km search radius, local paths). The driver options match that MATLAB driver (QC305 polygon is the valid area; vectors failing QC305 are only flagged).
